# forumulate_translation_override (Resource)

One reworded interface string for one language: the reader's "Sign in" or "Search the docs" in your own words. An override replaces the platform's shipped translation for the organization; destroying it returns the shipped wording.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_translation_override" "sign_in_es" {
  locale = "es"
  key    = "reader.sign_in"
  value  = "Entrar"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The interface string's key (1 to 120 characters). Changing it replaces the override.
- `locale` (String) The interface language: one of `en`, `es`, `fr`, `de`, `pt`, `ar`. Changing it replaces the override.
- `value` (String) The wording to show, up to 4000 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<locale>/<key>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_translation_override.sign_in_es es/reader.sign_in
```
